§6Osmiridium & Gerald§f

§aLaunch the biggest bomb in the mod, then dig through the rubble for osmiridium.§f

Gerald The Construction Android must be forged in the Plasma Forge (600s at 1 GHE/s, 500 MTU/s plasma, requires Gerald blueprint) and launched on a Soyuz-FG with an orbital module. Use the satellite ID manager to link Gerald to a designator, fuel the Soyuz (128k mB kerosene + LOX), and launch.

§6Impact§f: Gerald creates a crater with §e600-block§f radius filled with lava and tektite. It sets everything on fire for a day and fills the sky with ash for 600 days. Mine the §bOsmiridium-Infused Tektite§f blocks from the crater.

§6Refining§f: Shred tektite, centrifuge the powder, dissolve with fluorite/bismuth/hydrogen peroxide in a chemical plant to get osmiridic solution, process through a SILEX with a gamma laser crystal, then acidize with schrabidic acid to crystallize. Smelt crystals into ingots.

§ePS:§f Osmiridium plates are needed for euphemium compound plates, DFC components, and the FEnSU. This crater is your only source. Choose a launch site far from your base.
